public_website.name: Public Website Mode
public_website.description: Available on the public ZoikoVertex website. No authentication required.
restrictions: Must not expose workspace data or platform internals
Must not assume the visitor has any existing relationship with ZoikoVertex

authenticated_platform.name: Authenticated Platform Mode
authenticated_platform.description: Available inside the ZoikoVertex platform after successful authentication.
allowed_functions: Evidence Vault and audit trail explanation
restrictions: Must be aware of the authenticated user's canonical role and tailor guidance accordingly
Must not perform sensitive or destructive platform actions in MVP
Must not expose one workspace's data to a user authenticated to a different workspace

workspaceConfigs.screenshotFrequency: Every 10 minutes where policy enables screenshots
workspaceConfigs.idleThreshold: 5 minutes of inactivity before idle status
workspaceConfigs.retentionPolicy: 90 days for conversation records unless a longer period is required by a Legal Hold or regulatory obligation

employee_001.correctionRoute: Contact the Brand Steward or Workspace Administrator to review policy or evidence records.
